journal_lines: The water went dark beneath me. §oSomething vast, slow, not a fish. It passed. Did not surface.
A shadow below the surface too large to be a shadow. §oHeld position. It moved on. Stayed near the shallows after.
Something old in the deep water that was not interested in me specifically. §oThat felt like a narrow escape.
Eye in the deep that did not belong to anything with a name I had. §oIt looked. I looked. The ocean kept moving.
The shadow moved against the current. §oNot fighting it — just indifferent to it. Stayed very still.
Heard a low sound travel up through the water into my legs. §oDoors, or something like doors, closing far below.
Vast and slow. §oSlower than the water around it, which moved to accommodate. Kept to the surface until land.
It passed underneath and did not stop. The water was colder for a while after. Did not go deep the rest of the day.
